value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Round-3 CodeRabbit findings on PR 16, all resolved in source with revert-verified regression tests:

- transfer.ts + gatesim.ts: locale-sensitive sorts feeding content-addressed hashes replaced with byte order (Buffer.compare) at three sites; pinned by gap/gate/episode byte-order tests that flip under a localeCompare revert.
- receipt.ts: two raw library keys normalizing to one name now refuse with duplicate_receipt_library instead of silently overwriting the first version.
- sweep.ts: MAX_SWEEP_ARMS (64) cap added to expandSearchSpace with the typed search_space_too_large refusal, plus one shared METRIC_NAME_PATTERN and an isSelectionRuleKind guard replacing duplicated regex/kind checks.
- index.ts: rl run start now declares the optional --receipt-file flag its handler already read.
- README.md: GateEpisode and MergeOutcome rows added so the What-it-tracks table lists all nine registered types.
- test/sweep.test.ts: parseSweepSpec refusals now assert typed codes; the before-anything-is-written plan test asserts neither sweep nor arm exists after each refusal.
- transfer.ts: per_metric docstring now states the Number.NaN hole and its null JSON serialization.

Revert-proof verification: each behavioural fix was temporarily reverted via git stash and its pinned test confirmed FAILING (receipt duplicate: 1 fail; arm cap: 2 fails across unit and plan tests; transfer byte sort: 1 fail; gatesim byte sorts: 2 fails; receipt-file flag: 1 fail), then restored.

patch.value: All eleven round-3 threads addressed: byte-order canonical sorting at three hash-feeding sites (transfer.ts gaps, gatesim.ts gate results and stored episodes), duplicate normalized library names refused in receipts, MAX_SWEEP_ARMS cap with typed search_space_too_large refusal, one shared metric-name pattern, --receipt-file declared on rl run start, typed refusal codes and no-write state assertions pinned in tests, README type table completed to all nine types, and per_metric NaN-hole documented. Gates: npm test 235/235 pass; release:check fully green including coverage 17 files at 100/100/100 and changelog check; ./node_modules/.bin/pm health --strict-exit exit 0. Every behavioural fix revert-verified: pinned test confirmed failing under git stash of the fix, passing restored.
